# Fengari API reference

Fengari mirrors the Lua 5.3 C API by name. This reference is generated from the
public `module.exports` assignments and their source declarations; comments are
included when present. For usage guidance see [the migration guide](migrating-from-c.md)
and the [README](../README.md).

The core functions operate on a `lua_State`; strings are byte arrays
(`Uint8Array`), and errors cross JS boundaries as exceptions or `lua_pcall`
status codes. Module-specific notes are in each section.

This reference covers the C API and top-level exports. See the
[high-level API guide](high-level-api.md) for `api`/`vfs` and the
[browser guide](browser.md) for the bundle, workers and persistence.

## Version profiles

The registry itself is documented above. Bundled profiles expose the following
target surfaces (the parser and VM remain Lua 5.3):

| Version | Highlights |
| --- | --- |
| 5.4 | `coroutine.close`, `warn`, the 5.4 `math.random`/`randomseed` API (xoshiro, per-state seeds) and `<const>`/`<close>` with `__close`, including the generic-for closing value. No yielding `__close` or 64-bit integers. |
| 5.3 | Current core: integers, bitwise operators, `utf8`, `string.pack`, `table.move`. |
| 5.2 | `bit32`; no `utf8`, `string.pack` or 5.3 `math`/`coroutine` additions. |
| 5.1 | `unpack`, `loadstring`, `getfenv`/`setfenv`, `module`, `package.seeall`, `table.maxn/getn`, `string.gfind`, `package.loaders`. |
